t: Created on 1 May 1707 by the union of England and Scotland, with one Parliament at Westminster but separate Scottish law and church.
Naval power, public credit and trade made it the leading colonial power after the Seven Years’ War ended in 1763.
It lost the American colonies in 1783 but began the Industrial Revolution, and it merged with Ireland on 1 January 1801.
dyk: Scotland’s acceptance of the union was eased by the ‘Equivalent’, a payment of about £398,000 that partly compensated investors in the failed Darien colony in Panama.
ev: The Acts of Union join England and Scotland as Great Britain
George I becomes the first Hanoverian king
The Jacobite army is defeated at the Battle of Culloden
Quebec falls after the Battle of the Plains of Abraham
The Treaty of Paris gives Britain Canada and Florida
The thirteen American colonies declare independence
The Treaty of Paris recognises the independence of the United States
The Acts of Union with Ireland create the United Kingdom from 1 January 1801

f.predecessor: Kingdom of England; Kingdom of Scotland
f.successor: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland
